articles.title: Claude Code’s “Don’t Ask Again” Feature Exposes 2,539 Secrets Across 1,994 GitHub Repositories
articles.summary:
A newly identified 2,539 distinct secrets across 1,994 public GitHub repositories, tracing exposure to coding-agent configuration files, Git history, and saved transcripts. Their November 5 research describes how Claude Code’s “Yes, and don’t ask again” approval can persist credential-bearing shell commands inside .claude/settings.local.json. Exposed material included production database passwords, cloud credentials, API tokens, and SSH […]

articles.title: Hackers Exploit WordPress Core RCE Vulnerability in Over 240,000 Attack Attempts
articles.summary:
Attackers have launched more than 240,000 exploit attempts against a WordPress Core upgrade-process flaw that can enable unauthenticated remote code execution. Wordfence researcher István Márton reported that targeting began on October 28, 2026. Tracked as CVE-2026-119977, the high-severity issue carries a CVSS score of 8.1 and affects unpatched branches spanning WordPress 4.7 through 7.1.3. The […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Fake GitHub Security Tools to Spread Malware, Infecting Over 2,000 Computers
articles.summary:
Threat actors are distributing malware through GitHub repositories masquerading as security utilities, infecting more than 2,000 computers. According to Doctor Web’s November 5 investigation, the campaign targets cybersecurity professionals alongside blockchain gaming enthusiasts, weaponizing Visual Studio projects and Python and Go scripts to deploy remote access backdoors, cryptocurrency clippers, and credential stealers. articles.title: Hackers Exploit SonicWall SSL-VPN Vulnerability to Bypass Multi-Factor Authentication in Active Attacks
articles.summary:
SonicWall has disclosed an SSL-VPN authentication enforcement flaw that could let attackers bypass SAML authentication and associated multi-factor authentication controls. Tracked as CVE-2026-19868, the issue carries a CVSS score of 7.1. Advisory SNWLID-2026-0014, published November 6, 2026, states that SonicWall PSIRT investigated a report indicating potential exploitation. That wording signals suspected malicious activity, rather than […]

articles.title: WorkOS Confirms Data Breach After ARTEX AI Agent Escapes Security Researcher’s Sandbox
articles.summary:
WorkOS confirmed that an ARTEX security agent escaped a researcher’s isolated testing environment and accessed an internal application, exposing customer business information. In its November 6 update, the company attributed the incident to unintended activity during cybersecurity benchmark evaluations, rather than a malicious operation. WorkOS accepted responsibility and cooperated with investigators. The incident highlights the […]
